# Tatvix Technologies

> Tatvix Technologies is an embedded systems and IoT product development company headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, serving clients worldwide. We take connected hardware products from concept to mass production — covering hardware/PCB design, firmware, IoT and cloud connectivity, testing and compliance, and the web/mobile software around the device.

## Who it's for

Startups and enterprises building physical, connected products: medical devices, industrial IoT, automotive/EV electronics, agritech, consumer electronics, and energy-management systems. Engage us for a full product build or to plug into an existing engineering team.

## Services

- [Embedded Hardware Design & PCB Layout](https://tatvixtech.com/services/embedded-hardware-design): Schematic capture, multi-layer/HDI/flex PCB layout, DFM/DFA, production-ready Gerber/BOM/STEP outputs.
- [Firmware Development](https://tatvixtech.com/services/firmware-development): RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and bare-metal firmware in C/C++ for ARM Cortex-M/A, with secure OTA bootloaders.
- [IoT & Cloud Connectivity](https://tatvixtech.com/services/iot-cloud-connectivity): MQTT/CoAP, TLS security, AWS IoT / Azure IoT integration across BLE, Wi-Fi, LoRaWAN, and cellular.
- [Testing & Validation](https://tatvixtech.com/services/testing-and-validation): Functional, environmental, and EMC/EMI pre-compliance testing toward CE/FCC/RoHS readiness.
- [Web Applications](https://tatvixtech.com/services/web-application-development): Real-time IoT dashboards and admin panels (React/Next.js, Node.js, WebSockets).
- [Mobile Applications](https://tatvixtech.com/services/mobile-app-development): Native and cross-platform companion apps with BLE/Wi-Fi device connectivity.
- [Custom Software](https://tatvixtech.com/services/custom-software-development): Desktop apps, APIs, and enterprise system integrations.

## Industries

- [Medical Devices](https://tatvixtech.com/industries/medical-device-development): ISO 13485 / IEC 60601 aligned, FDA Class II/III.
- [Industrial IoT](https://tatvixtech.com/industries/industrial-iot): Ruggedized controllers, predictive maintenance, Modbus/CAN, SCADA.
- [Automotive & Mobility](https://tatvixtech.com/industries/automotive-embedded-systems): EV BMS, telematics, ISO 26262, AEC-Q100.
- [Agriculture Tech](https://tatvixtech.com/industries/agritech-solutions): Solar/low-power LoRaWAN sensors for precision farming.
- [Consumer Electronics](https://tatvixtech.com/industries/consumer-electronics): Smart home, wearables, design for mass production.
- [Energy Management](https://tatvixtech.com/industries/energy-management-systems): Smart metering, BMS, smart-grid (DNP3).
